title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint
Low back pain.

HPI
The patient is a 36-year-old woman who presents today for evaluation of localized low back pain. She reports that the discomfort began approximately two weeks ago after she spent a weekend lifting heavy boxes. She describes the pain as a dull ache in the lumbar region that occasionally radiates to her upper gluteal muscles. She notes that the pain is exacerbated by prolonged sitting or bending forward but is partially relieved by rest and the application of heat. She denies any numbness, tingling, or weakness in her lower extremities. She has attempted over-the-counter ibuprofen with mild success.

Medication List
Ibuprofen 400 mg as needed.

Exam
The patient is alert and in no acute distress. She is upright and moving comfortably. Physical exam reveals tenderness to palpation over the lumbar paraspinal muscles. Range of motion of the spine is slightly limited by discomfort. There are no, and no neurological deficits are noted in the lower extremities. Reflexes are 2+ and symmetric.

Assessment
1. Low back pain.

Plan
The patient will continue with conservative management. I recommended alternating heat and ice therapy and prescribed a regimen of physical therapy to focus on core strengthening and stretching. She will follow up in four weeks to assess progress.

Problem List
1. COPD
2. Status post appendectomy
3. Status post cholecystectomy

Electronically signed, L. Moreau, DO, 05/12/2026
explanations: COPD appears only in a problem list and is not addressed in this encounter, so it is not supported for this date of service.

distractors.why: A problem-list entry alone does not show the condition affected care at this visit.
